cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

mechanism: Copy a diner's protective card gesture as preparation for a contest, then formalize a harmless proposed settlement into a scored rematch with a penalty.
confusable: Not a knowledgeable game organizer: B2 must expose why the copied face-down card is unrelated to play.
comparison: Dinner partners negotiate a tip decider instead of competitors responding to equal judging marks.
seedUse: Retains exact bill split and tip stake; replaces arbitrary waiter apology with a concrete mistaken card-game setup.
